family: All simple labeled 43-vertex graphs for which some 26-vertex induced subgraph has neither an induced P5 nor an induced complement of P5; all remaining 17 vertices and their incident edges arbitrary
success_gate: Prove a complete-class upper bound 25 for (P5, complement-P5)-free graphs with clique and independence numbers at most four, and consequently exclude the entire specified 43-vertex family
method: Structural substitution decomposition into perfect graphs and C5; exact small weighted capacity induction
boundary_validation: Check any claimed 25-vertex extremal graph literally; do not treat it as good43 or a candidate extension
failure_gate: If the complete bound cannot be justified, preserve the failed proof obligation without publishing a global exclusion
forbidden_continuations: No old triangle-support, carrier quotient, cut-rank occupancy, fixed-neighborhood gluing, or saved-parent repair; no threshold ladder after this gate
external_inputs_to_verify: Fouquet decomposition theorem for P5 and complement-P5 free graphs
computation_role: Exact finite arithmetic and semantic validation, not a capped monolithic target solve
